system.description: The ability to successfully bring goods to market, and all that entails: evaluating various goods and how to best market them to the populace, knowledge of trade routes and fairs, and skill at negotiating prices. Choose one class of goods as a field of expertise when you first purchase it; additional fields of expertise can be bought with Experience or Free Traits, just as with Linguistics and languages. Outside your field of expertise, Commerce can still identify potential markets and experts, and negotiate or haggle over just about anything — but evaluating an item or trade route you have no experience with is beyond your grasp. In the Dark Medieval, the line between legitimate and illegitimate trade is fuzzy to non-existent, so Commerce comes into play as much buying cheese as hiring a mercenary, soliciting a courtesan, or selling black-market goods — conveying a general sense of the shadier side of life, what modern folk call "streetwise."
